description:
You are an energy engineer modeling a retrofit for a commercial office building in Phoenix. To reduce peak cooling demand, you must implement Direct Evaporative Pre-cooling on all Top Floor (T.*) packaged single-zone HVAC systems in the '4StoreyBuilding' eQUEST model.

Your task is to locate the five Top Floor systems (T.S31, T.E32, T.N33, T.W34, T.C35) and update their cooling configuration with the following specifications:
- Pre-Cool Type (EVAP-PRECOOL-TYPE): DIRECT
- Effectiveness (EVAP-PRECOOL-EFF): 0.85
- Circulation Pump Power (EVAP-PUMP-PWR): 0.06 kW/1000cfm

These parameters are located in the 'Cooling' tab of the System Properties, specifically under the 'Evap Precool' sub-tab or section.

After configuring all five systems, run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation to capture the energy impact, and then save the project.
